name: National Training Complaints Hotline
provider: Department of Employment and Workplace Relations
summary: A national phone line and form for complaints about your training experience in VET, referred to the right authority.
who: Anyone with a complaint about their experience while doing vocational training.
how: Call 13 38 73 or complete the online complaints form.
catches: The hotline refers your complaint to the authority best placed to handle it. It doesn't decide it itself.
Category is the closest fit: this is a complaints service.

evidence.quote: the National Training Complaints Hotline can refer your complaint to the most appropriate authority
